info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Cerussite Notebook Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Cerussite Notebook Detail API enables businesses to efficiently create and manage detailed entries for Cerussite notebooks. This endpoint allows users to submit comprehensive information about each notebook, enhancing inventory tracking and product management. Typically utilized by inventory managers and product teams, this API streamlines the documentation and categorization process, ensuring accurate records are maintained. By centralizing notebook details, businesses can improve their operational efficiency and decision-making capabilities.

post.summary: Create a new cerussite notebook detail.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new detail for the cerussite notebook. Ensure that all required fields are filled, and that you follow the data format specified in the request body.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary information to create a new entry in the Cerussite Notebook details. The data must adhere to the prescribed schema format, ensuring all required fields are populated accordingly.

200.description: The request was successful and the notebook details are returned.

CreateCatalogCerussiteNotebookDetailRequ.title: Cerussite Notebook Details Request

cerussite_notebook_id.description: Unique identifier for the Cerussite notebook.

requestedBy.description: Name of the person making the request.

quantity.description: The quantity of the Cerussite notebooks requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates if the request is a priority.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the Cerussite notebook.
